FVTTCONDITIONS.Condition.distracted.Name: Distracted
FVTTCONDITIONS.Condition.enfeebled.Name: Enfeebled

FVTTCONDITIONS.Condition.frozen.Name: Frozen
FVTTCONDITIONS.Condition.frozen.Descript:
Your Speed becomes 0, and you cannot benefit from any bonus to your Speed. If you are flying, you fall.

Attack rolls against you have advantage.

When you are attacked with a weapon that deals bludgeoning damage, any hit against you is a Critical Hit.

You or another creature can spend 1 Action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against the condition's listed DC to end it.

It also ends once you have taken the condition's listed cumulative bludgeoning or fire damage threshold (20 by default).
FVTTCONDITIONS.Condition.helpless.Name: Helpless
FVTTCONDITIONS.Condition.helpless.Descri: Any attack that hits you is a Critical Hit.
FVTTCONDITIONS.Condition.immobilized.Des: Your Speed becomes 0, and you cannot benefit from any bonus to your Speed. A flying target falls.
FVTTCONDITIONS.Condition.jinxed.Name: Jinxed
FVTTCONDITIONS.Condition.jinxed.Descript: Whenever you make an attack roll or saving throw, roll X and subtract the result from the roll.
FVTTCONDITIONS.Condition.shocked.Name: Shocked
FVTTCONDITIONS.Condition.shocked.Descrip:
On your turn, choose one: move, take an Action, or take a Bonus Action.

Attack rolls against you have advantage.

You immediately drop held items. Picking up, drawing, or stowing an item requires 1 Action.
FVTTCONDITIONS.Condition.sickened.Name: Sickened
FVTTCONDITIONS.Condition.slowed.Name: Slowed
FVTTCONDITIONS.Condition.staggered.Name: Staggered
FVTTCONDITIONS.Condition.staggered.Descr: On your turn, you can make at most one weapon or unarmed attack.
FVTTCONDITIONS.Condition.valor.Name: Valor
FVTTCONDITIONS.Condition.valor.Descripti: Whenever you make an attack roll or saving throw, roll X and add the result to the roll.
FVTTCONDITIONS.Condition.weakened.Name: Weakened
FVTTCONDITIONS.Condition.weakened.Descri: The total damage from a weapon attack or spell is halved, rounding the result down.

FVTTCONDITIONS.Injury.Name: Injury
FVTTCONDITIONS.Injury.ManagerSummary: Injury has 0–3 levels. Current levels are shown separately for each Actor below; the GM decides a third-level fall.
FVTTCONDITIONS.Injury.EnabledHint: Automate injury rules for managed Actors.
FVTTCONDITIONS.Injury.ManageNpcsHint: Also apply injury automation to NPCs.
FVTTCONDITIONS.Injury.ThreeStackPrompt: Three injuries: the GM must decide whether this fall causes death or an exception.
FVTTCONDITIONS.Injury.Rules:
Injury has 0–3 levels. A creature first dropping from positive HP to 0 opens a death episode; its first recovery above 0 adds one Injury level. Stabilizing at 0 does not add a level.

On a later drop to 0, 0–2 Injury levels become the same number of starting death-save failures. At 3 levels, the GM decides direct death or an exception before any failures are written.

A retained natural 19 or 20 on a death save counts as a critical success and revives at 1 HP. Discarded dice do not count.

Real healing to full HP and a completed short or long rest clear Injury. A successful Fading Spirits resurrection can suppress the next recovery level through its public interface.
